checks.name: inscripcion_fechas_estado_check
checks.expression:
(fec_anu_ins IS NULL OR fec_anu_ins >= fei_ins)
                AND
                (fec_ret_ins IS NULL OR fec_ret_ins >= fei_ins)
                AND
                (fec_con_ins IS NULL OR fec_con_ins >= fei_ins)

checks.name: horario_detalle_plan_check
checks.expression:
(cod_pas IS NOT NULL AND cod_pes IS NULL)
                OR
                (cod_pas IS NULL AND cod_pes IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: documento_inscripcion_for_check
checks.expression:
for_die IS NULL
                OR for_die IN ('PDF', 'JPG', 'JPEG', 'PNG', 'DOCX', 'XLSX', 'ZIP')

checks.name: documento_inscripcion_fechas_check
checks.expression:
fec_pre_die IS NULL
                OR fec_lim_die IS NULL
                OR fec_pre_die >= fec_lim_die
                OR est_die IN ('PRESENTADO', 'VALIDADO', 'OBSERVADO')

checks.name: inscripcion_fechas_estado_check
checks.expression:
(fec_anu_ins IS NULL OR fec_anu_ins >= fei_ins)
                AND
                (fec_ret_ins IS NULL OR fec_ret_ins >= fei_ins)
                AND
                (fec_con_ins IS NULL OR fec_con_ins >= fei_ins)

checks.name: horario_detalle_plan_check
checks.expression:
(cod_pas IS NOT NULL AND cod_pes IS NULL)
                OR
                (cod_pas IS NULL AND cod_pes IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: lms_submission_score_check
checks.expression: pun_max > 0 AND pun_obt >= 0 AND pun_obt <= pun_max

checks.name: documento_inscripcion_for_check
checks.expression:
for_die IS NULL
                OR for_die IN ('PDF', 'JPG', 'JPEG', 'PNG', 'DOCX', 'XLSX', 'ZIP')

checks.name: documento_inscripcion_fechas_check
checks.expression:
fec_pre_die IS NULL
                OR fec_lim_die IS NULL
                OR fec_pre_die >= fec_lim_die
                OR est_die IN ('PRESENTADO', 'VALIDADO', 'OBSERVADO')

checks.name: seguimiento_domain_check
checks.expression: version_catalogo > 0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(mot_seg), '') IS NOT NULL AND vis_seg IN ('NORMAL','RESTRINGIDO') AND (NOT visible_estudiante OR vis_seg = 'NORMAL') AND (fec_pro_seg IS NULL OR fec_pro_seg >= fec_ape_seg) AND (fec_cie_seg IS NULL OR fec_cie_seg >= fec_ape_seg)

checks.name: seguimiento_revision_check
checks.expression: tipo IN ('RECTIFICACION','ANULACION','CAMBIO_ESTADO','SEGUIMIENTO') AND NULLIF(TRIM(motivo), '') IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(datos) = 'object'

checks.name: seguimiento_evidence_check
checks.expression: bytes > 0 AND sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND ruta LIKE 'kardex/%'

checks.name: units_content_check
checks.expression: orden > 0 AND NULLIF(TRIM(titulo), '') IS NOT NULL AND (archivada_at IS NULL OR NOT publicada)

checks.name: academic_goal_content_check
checks.expression: estado IN ('BORRADOR','ACTIVA','COMPLETADA','CANCELADA') AND NULLIF(TRIM(titulo), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(objetivo), '') IS NOT NULL

checks.name: academic_goal_revision_check
checks.expression: NULLIF(TRIM(motivo), '') IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(datos) = 'object'

checks.name: calendar_event_content_check
checks.expression: ffi_cae >= fii_cae AND ((hoi_cae IS NULL AND hof_cae IS NULL) OR (hoi_cae IS NOT NULL AND hof_cae IS NOT NULL AND hof_cae > hoi_cae)) AND (cod_par IS NULL OR cod_cur IS NOT NULL) AND (cod_cae_ori IS NULL OR cod_cae_ori <> cod_cae) AND est_cae IN ('PREALERTA','CONFIRMADO','CANCELADO','FINALIZADO') AND efe_cae IN ('INFORMATIVO','SIN_CLASES','SUSPENSION_PARCIAL','INGRESO_DIFERIDO','SALIDA_ANTICIPADA','HORARIO_AJUSTADO','RECUPERACION','ACTIVIDAD_INSTITUCIONAL') AND NULLIF(TRIM(mot_cae), '') IS NOT NULL

checks.name: calendar_event_revision_check
checks.expression: NULLIF(TRIM(motivo), '') IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(datos) = 'object'
